title: Implantable Automatic Defibrillators (ICDs)
description: CMS coverage policy for primary and secondary prevention implantable cardioverter defibrillators. Mandates documented severe systolic dysfunction (LVEF <= 35%), NYHA Class II/III, at least 90 days of guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT), post-event waiting periods, and absence of cardiogenic shock.
scope_note: Curated benchmark criterion schema targeting primary statutory indications, exclusions, and waiting periods; not an exhaustive legal transcription of full multi-page CMS coverage manuals.

criteria.name: Severe LV Systolic Dysfunction (LVEF <= 35%)
criteria.description: Documented Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF) <= 35% on diagnostic echocardiography, cardiac MRI, or radionucleotide ventriculography.

criteria.name: Heart Failure Functional Classification (NYHA II/III)
criteria.description: Patient classified as New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class II or Class III functional heart failure symptoms.

criteria.name: Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy Duration (>=90 Days)
criteria.description: Patient has received optimal guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) including beta-blocker, ACEi/ARB/ARNI, and MRA for at least 90 days (3 months).
criteria.clinical_intent: Ensure medical optimization trial before device implantation

criteria.name: Cardiomyopathy Etiology & Revascularization Timeline
criteria.description: Ischemic cardiomyopathy >= 40 days post-MI or >= 90 days post-CABG/PCI, or non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy >= 9 months.
criteria.clinical_intent: Enforce mandatory myocardial stunning recovery period

criteria.name: Cardiogenic Shock or Terminal Illness Exclusion
criteria.description: Exclusion: Patient has active cardiogenic shock or non-cardiac disease with life expectancy less than 1 year (e.g., metastatic cancer, hospice).
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude non-beneficial device placement under futile conditions
